mapper.select: SELECT c.definition_id,d.process_key,d.name,d.status,COALESCE(d.version,0) AS version,d.revision, c.template_version,c.copied_by,c.copied_at FROM template_copy c JOIN approval_definition d ON d.tenant_id=c.tenant_id AND d.id=c.definition_id WHERE c.tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND c.template_key=#{templateKey} ORDER BY c.copied_at DESC,c.definition_id
